name: Ambient Occlusion Specific Distance Function
aliases: Distance function for a cube sized 3D texture (AO variant)
Distance function for a cube sized 3D texture. Version for ambient occlusion
definition: A variant of the 3D texture distance function specifically designed for use in the ambient occlusion algorithm to mitigate artifacts caused by the bounding shell of the texture volume contributing to occlusion calculations.
summary: This specialized distance function prevents bounding shell artifacts in ambient occlusion by returning a constant step size for points outside the texture volume.
